product: Connect Claude to Genie One with the Databricks Genie connector
tagline: The Databricks Genie connector connects Claude to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from Claude.
what_it_does: The Databricks Genie connector connects Claude to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from Claude. A Claude admin connects it for the team, and each user connects by signing in with their Databricks account. The Genie One MCP server is a Databricks provided MCP that exposes Genie as a conversational tool over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), leveraging Chat in Genie One.
why_it_matters: Genie resolves business terms, metric definitions, and table relationships through Genie Ontology, your governed semantic layer, which produces more accurate answers than an agent writing SQL directly against raw tables.
plain_summary: The Databricks Genie connector connects Claude to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from Claude. A Claude admin connects it for the team, and each user connects by signing in with their Databricks account.
